LESSON: COMMUNITY LEADERSHIP

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Citizenship and Governance in Kenya
Topic 5.6: Community Leadership

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

SECTION 2: TEACHING CONTENT

” to allow audio playback COMMUNITY LEADERS IN THE COUNTY Music Hello learner. Welcome to a social studies lesson for grade 4 learners. Today, we are going to learn about community leaders in the county. Your radio teacher is Esther Simaloi. Welcome to the program. Music

” to allow audio playback Hello grade four learner welcome to our social studies lesson. Today, we are going to learn about community leaders in the county. Learner, mention any leader you know in Kenya. Mention any leader you know in Kenya. #Bell# Good. I hope your answers include; Our president The governor of your county The Senators The chief of your area, and Religious leaders in your area. Religious leaders in your area. Who is a leader? #Bell# A leader is the head of a group who share the same interests and goals. A leader is the head of a group who share the same interests and goals. In unit one. We learned that Kenya is divided into 47 counties. Learner of the 47 counties, which is your county. Which is your county? #Bell# Who is the governor of your county? Who is the governor of your county? #Bell# Very well, there are different types of leaders in the community. Community leaders lead people in a community. They are very important. Who are the community leaders in your community? Who are the community leaders in your community? #Bell# Good. Different communities have leaders who guide them. Such leaders include; Council of Elders. Chiefs Cultural leaders and Religious leaders. Let us talk about the Council of Elders in some of the communities here in Kenya. Does your community have a council of elders? Does your community have a council of elders? #Bell# A council of elders represents the interests of the community. They also help to find solutions to the challenges faced by the people they lead.

” to allow audio playback The Council of Elders have the following responsibilities. They settle disputes among the community members. When people living in the community had a disagreement, the Council of Elders would intervene and solve the issues. They are peacemakers in the community, The Council of Elders made sure that community, customs and practices that foster harmony,order and peace are passed on to the next generation. The elders are teachers. They teach the young about moral values like peace, Justice, humility, truthfulness, cooperation, unity and many other values. Elders are instrumental in creating a harmonious relationship between people and God. Elders unite community members. They helped in conservation of the environment. Trees were not cut down unnecessarily. Some of the communities that have the Council of Elders include; The Ameru The Agikuyu The Luo council of elders. The luo council of elders. Who is your religious leader? Who is your religious leader? #Bell# Religious leaders are also important leaders in the community. Sheiks and imams are leaders of the Muslim community. They lead the Islamic worship services. Bishops, priests and pastors are leaders of the Christian community. They lead Christian worship services. What are the duties of community leaders in your county? What are the duties of community leaders in your county? #Bell# Good. Some of the duties of community leaders in the community include; They unite the community they lead. They unite the community they lead. They maintain law and order thus promoting peace and harmony. They maintain law and order, thus promoting peace and harmon They care and protect the interests and welfare of all their members. They care and protect the interests and welfare of all their members. Community leaders resolve disputes among members. Community leaders resolve disputes among members. They encourage cooperation among the members of the community. They encourage cooperation among the members of the community. They promote security among the members of the community. They promote security among the members of the community. To conclude the lesson with the help of your parents or guardians. Tell your friends three things that your community leaders are doing to prevent the spread of corona virus in your community. And with that, we come to the end of our lesson for today. Until next time. Goodbye.

” to allow audio playback Hello grade four learner. Welcome to our social studies lesson. Today, we are going to learn about the qualities of a good leader in the community . In the previous lesson, we learned about community leaders in the county. Let us remind ourselves a few things that we learned. Learner, Who is a leader? Who is a leader? #Bell# Well done. A leader is the head of a group who shared the same interests or goals. A leader is the head of a group who share the same interests or goals. We also learned that community leaders had duties this include. Uniting the community they lead, uniting the community they lead. Maintaining law and order in the community thus promoting peace and harmony, maintaining law and order in the community thus promoting peace and harmony. Resolving disputes among community members, resolving disputes among community members and Protect the interests of all their members, protect the interest of all their members. For example, in today's situation with the Corona virus pandemic, community leaders are working round the clock in helping to curb the spread of the corona virus by encouraging their members to; Wear masks Wash their hands regularly, and Sanitize their hands. Learner, how else has your community leader adviced you to do to help in stopping the spread of the Corona virus? How else has your community leader advised you to do to help in stopping the spread of the Corona virus? #Bell# Well done . I hope your answer was, keep the social distance. Who are the leaders at school? Who are your leaders at school? #Bell# What do you like about your leaders? What do you like about your leaders? #Bell#

” to allow audio playback Well done. A good leader should have the following qualities , Honest. Honesty is when you speak the truth and act truthfully. It is not doing what is wrong. Therefore, the leader should do what is right for the community. He or she should be just and fair to all members in the community. A good leader should listen and learn from others. He should listen and learn from others. A good leader should lead by example. A good leader should lead by example. A good leader should inspire others. A good leader should inspire others. A good leader should bring people together. A good leader should bring people together that is unite people in the community they lead. A good leader is humble. He is humble. A good leader thinks about the future of the community. He thinks about the future of the community. A good leader is trusted. He is trusted. A good leader helps the needy. He helps the needy in his community. And A good leader helps in conserving the environment, he helps in conserving the environment. Qualities of a bad leader include. They are corrupt. Corruption is the practice of buying a favor from another person. It is the practice of buying a favor from another person. They are selfish. They are selfish They do not listen to anyone. They do not listen to anyone. They do what they think is right to them. They are not obedient to the rule of law. They are not obedient to the rule of law. and They can not be trusted. They can not be trusted. Anyone can be a leader. You can learn good leadership skills and become a great leader. In conclusion, if you were a village elder in your community, what would you do to show you are a good leader today? #Bell# And with that, we come to the end of our lesson for today. Until next time, keep safe. Goodbye.

” to allow audio playback Hallo learner, welcome to our social studies grade 4 lesson. Today we shall learn about qualities of good citizenship in school. So get your book and pencil and let us learn social studies. I am your radio teacher Eugene Kimani. Music I hope you have the book and pen ready and set to learn. We are going to start the lesson by remembering what we learnt about community leadership in our county. What does a community leader do in the county? Music I hope you were able to answer what a community leader does. Very good . A community leader: Teaches people about good values in the society. Examples of values are honesty, loyalty, kindness, truthfulness and so on. Community leader solves problems in the community. They guide people to know what is right and wrong. They lead people in prayers and worship. They make sure the culture and traditions of the community are not forgotten. They lead people in cultural events in the community. Now that we have said what a community leader does, Let’s get to today’s topic. We shall talk about qualities of good citizenship in school. Now who is a citizen? Music Very good, a citizen is a person who belongs to a particular place or country. Now let us look at what is citizenship? Citizenship is the act of belonging to a country and enjoying the rights that the citizens of that country enjoy. What can you do in school to make you a good learner? Answer when you hear the music Music Very good, we do things like: Help one another in doing various things. Keeping the school clean. Being at peace with others at all times. Sharing with one another. What are some the good qualities of learners in school? Answer when you hear the music. Music Very good, I hope you have said some of the qualities. I will now say some good qualities of learners in school. A good learner should be kind to others. A good learner should be honest. A good learner should be caring. A good learner should be obedient. A good learner should be responsible. A good learner should be hardworking. A good learner should be humble. A good learner should be tolerant. You can mention more if you have any.

” to allow audio playback I am now going to read out qualities of a learner. Write down if you hear any bad qualities of a learner. Are you ready? Here I go. Kind; disobedient; honest; lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. I repeat, write down if you hear any bad quality of a learner. Here I go. Kind; disobedient; honest; lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. Did you write the bad qualities that you have heard? Music Very good, from our list, the following are the bad qualities of a bad learner. Disobedient, lazy, rude, irresponsible, a bully, greedy and selfish. Before doing something, we should always ask ourselves the following questions. Question 1 Will my teacher be happy with what I am going to do? Question 2 Will my parents be happy with what I am going to do? Question 3 Will what I am going to do help other learners in school? Question 4 Will what I am going to do help me do well in school? When we practice good citizenship in school, there is good performance. Things in school are taken well care of and there is peace and harmony. I am now going to read out good qualities of a learner. Write down if you hear any qualities of a good learner. Are you ready? Here I go. Kind, disobedient, honest, lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. Did you write the good qualities that you have heard? Let me read them again. Kind, disobedient, honest, lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. Music I hope you have written the following words: Kind, honest, caring, tolerant, hardworking and humble. Learner, show how you can be a good child at home.
